COALITION RESOLVE MODE

No rewind. Coalition Resolve tracked between Washington, London, Chongqing, and Canberra.

WHERE THE WAR IS AT

July 1941. Japan has just occupied southern Indochina, and how strictly Washington enforces the resulting freeze on Japanese assets is still a honestly open administrative question. This command is about to help answer it, for better or worse.

"Yesterday, December 7, 1941, a date which will live in infamy."

— PRESIDENT ROOSEVELT

A PLUS READING MEANS BETTER SUPPLIED AND RUNNING AHEAD OF SCHEDULE. A MINUS READING MEANS THE REVERSE.

A war that pressed for Pacific parity at Arcadia over King's own objections to Europe First, and fought a different middle, reaches its final chapter choosing not to reduce that divergence to a single number. American industrial capacity and the Manhattan Project weren't contingent on any of these operational choices, and the war's broad ending was never fully up for grabs regardless. What this specific road changed about the fleet's condition and the war's real cost stays real without being reduced to a precision even the official postwar casualty count, by its own compilers' admission, couldn't fully claim for every category it tried to reconcile.

COUNCIL FOLLOWED

Most trusted advisor: Nimitz (2 councils) · also heeded Acheson (1), Pye (1)

VOICES NOT HEARD

Passed over most often: Marshall (3), King (3)

OBJECTIVES ACHIEVED

THE DICE YOU ROLLED

This war passed through 1 contested outcome. The compound likelihood of the exact path you walked: ~50%.

COMMAND TIMELINE · 6 DIVERGENCES FROM THE RECORD
SCORECARD VS. HISTORY · MATCHED 3/6, OUT-POSITIONED 1/6
DECISION LOG
JULY 1941 — Let the strict interpretation stand: a de facto total oil embargo
DECEMBER 1941 — Recall the relief force: preserve Saratoga and her escort rather than risk them against a force already converging on the island
DECEMBER 1941 – JANUARY 1942 — Back King's case: argue for near-parity Pacific resourcing given Japan struck first
FEBRUARY 1942 — Reject the removal order: side with the Justice Department's objection, pursue individualized security review instead
MARCH – APRIL 1942 — Order a fighting retreat toward the Indian border: preserve the army over the city
1942 — Bank the resourcing win cautiously: use it to shore up defenses rather than accelerate offense
1944 — Open a channel of material support to Communist forces in the north as a hedge against Chiang's weakening position (The support arrives too late and too thin)
1945 — Treat the extra resourcing as a bigger war fought at the same pace
